modules.title: Introduction to Databases
modules.html:
Tables, fields, records, queries and database management systems. This section covers introduction to databases.

Key points

  • Study the meaning, main features and examples of databases.
  • Be able to explain databases in your own words and give examples.
  • Practise the 50-question quiz for this topic until you score well without notes.

Worked examples

Q: Which of the following is a spreadsheet application?
A: Lotus 1-2-3 — Lotus 1-2-3 was a popular spreadsheet program before Excel became dominant.

Q: Which key capitalizes letters?
A: Caps Lock — Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Caps Lock.

quiz.q: Which of the following is a spreadsheet application?
quiz.solution: Lotus 1-2-3 was a popular spreadsheet program before Excel became dominant.

quiz.q: Which key capitalizes letters?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Caps Lock.

quiz.q: Which key deletes characters to the left of the cursor?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Backspace.

quiz.q: Which part of the CPU is responsible for performing mathematical calculations?
quiz.solution: The Arithmetic and Logic Unit (ALU) performs all arithmetic (addition, subtraction) and logical (comparisons) operations.

quiz.q: Which networking topology connects all devices to a single central cable?
quiz.solution: In a bus topology, all nodes are connected to a main transmission line (backbone).

quiz.q: Which of the following units is used to measure CPU speed?
quiz.solution: CPU speed is measured in cycles per second, known as Hertz (typically MHz or GHz).

quiz.q: Which of the following is a high-level language?
quiz.solution: Python is a high-level, interpreted, general-purpose programming language. Assembly and Machine code are low-level.

quiz.q: Which of the following is used for video output?
quiz.solution: Video Graphics Array (VGA) is a standard connector for computer video output.

quiz.q: The 'Home Row' on a QWERTY keyboard for the left hand is _____.
quiz.solution: In touch typing, the home row keys for the left hand are A, S, D, and F.

quiz.q: A network covering a small area like a building is:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: LAN.

quiz.q: Which is a permanent storage?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Hard Disk.

quiz.q: Algorithm is:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Step-by-step solution.

quiz.q: Which memory is fastest?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Cache.

quiz.q: A collection of related records is a:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: File.

quiz.q: Ctrl + Z is used for:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Undo.

quiz.q: ROM stands for:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Read Only Memory.

quiz.q: First generation used:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Vacuum Tubes.

quiz.q: Nibble is:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: 4 bits.

quiz.q: Warm Booting is:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Restarting.

quiz.q: What is the result of the Excel formula: $$ =SUM(10, 20, 30) $$
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: 60.

quiz.q: The process of finding and fixing errors in a program is...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Debugging.

quiz.q: Which of these is a permanent storage device?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Hard Disk.

quiz.q: The extension .doc represents:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Document (Word).

quiz.q: WWW:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: World Wide Web.

quiz.q: Ctrl+S:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Save.

quiz.q: Decision Symbol:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Diamond.

quiz.q: Soft Copy:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Screen/File.

quiz.q: MS Excel is used for:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: Spreadsheet/Calculation.

quiz.q: 1 Gigabyte equals:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: 1024 Megabytes.
